Hi Emily —

We're finalizing the roadmap/demo for your renewal and want to lock a time that works for the execs + procurement. We hear you on keeping this tight: our suggestion is a 45-minute condensed walkthrough focused on the rollout plan, cost/ops, and a ~10-minute technical deep dive.

Two available slots that work on our side:
- Tue Oct 18 — 09:00–09:45 ET (early West Coast friendly)
- Thu Oct 20 — 11:00–11:45 ET (post internal sync, we can expand to 60 if needed)

If both are blocked, our fallback is Fri Oct 21 — 08:00–08:45 PT (short notice but doable). Attached is a first-pass agenda and a run-of-show. Can you confirm which of the three slot windows you prefer? Also send the final attendee list (we'll ask Ben to own the technical portion).

Notes / asks:
- If procurement needs to be present, call them out now so we can move the slot earlier.
- Let us know whether you want the session recorded and whether any content needs pre-redaction.

Thanks —
Marissa
